answers.product.name: registration-toolkit
answers.product.description: A set of utilities written in C++ for simplifying image alignment tasks, supporting image-to-image and image-to-mesh registration.
answers.product.problem: Images of the same object captured at different times, with different cameras, or in different modalities do not line up, so they cannot be compared or combined; and there is no simple way to transfer a high-quality 2D image onto a 3D scan texture, or to flatten a scan texture into a single usable image.
product.users: Imaging researchers in digital heritage running the rt_* CLI tools
Pipeline operators running automated acquisition and registration workflows via the smgl render graph
Downstream C++ developers linking rt::core / rt::graph
guidelines.principles: Use mattpocock-skills grill-with-docs for ADRs and domain terms
answers.workflow.commits: Match current history: imperative descriptive summary, optional area: prefix, PRs squash-merged with (#N)
answers.workflow.review: Required for non-trivial changes (PR + review); docs/version bumps may go direct to develop
answers.styleguides.existing_configs: Yes, use .clang-format/.clang-tidy and existing code patterns
